neighbours.label: a modifier that predicts a following space/area noun ('living [room]', 'work [surface]', 'dining [area]', 'seating [area]')
fire: The flat has an open-plan kitchen that flows into a bright living room with tall windows.
Wipe down your work surface with a damp cloth before rolling out the dough.
The restaurant added an outdoor seating area for the summer months.
Guests can relax in the common room after a long day of hiking.
The house features a formal dining room and a large family kitchen.
Keep the food preparation area separate from where raw meat is stored.
Each student gets a quiet study space on the third floor of the library.
The office has a shared break room and a small storage area for supplies.
quiet: He made a modest living repairing bicycles in the back of his father's shop.
You need to work hard if you want to pass the exam in June.
They were dining with friends when the phone rang.
It is common for puppies to chew on shoes and furniture.
The seating plan for the wedding took her two whole evenings.
Preparation for the marathon began six months before the race.
She likes to study late at night with a cup of tea.
The team took a short break before the second half started.

notes: the + pole's output suppresses ' area'/' space', so this pole promotes them
